steps.name: Stocks (Global, whole market): a real series from completed sales, with totals that match the database
a busy card: Average Value and fair value are distinct, volume is units and Credits, targets are ranges, time to sell is inferred
a card with one old sale and a card with nothing: honest empty states, no invented line
an outlier sale does not move the Average Value of a card that trades rarely
Portfolio: cost basis from what was paid, imports say No cost basis, books, groups and a CSV export without private ids
Compare holds two to four exact cards with the same numbers, and says when a number is missing
Discover: what is moving comes from real sales; presets, saved views per realm and a search alert
an alert reaches the inbox once, from the server, when a real listing matches
the same pages fit 360, 390, 768, 1366 and 1920 wide, in saved monochrome and at Very Low and High quality
cost: one chart on Stocks, none per listing; the page draws quickly and the Worker reports its query cost
no page errors and no unexpected console messages
